alternatives.argument: The complete local proof derives P=(gamma mc,gamma mv), the mass shell and v=c^2p/E, differentiates the shell to obtain dE/dt=F·v, and separately differentiates eta(mU,mU)=-m^2c^2 for the C1 variable-mass ansatz.

The future-cone sum lemma gives causal character and strict timelikeness; singleton Cauchy–Schwarz gives the null-ray equality case; the total rest frame and observer-energy mass shell give M>=sum m and its exact co-moving equality condition.

The local definition explicitly supplies finite nonempty same-event lists, nonzero future-causal legs, recorded masses and null scale, vector totals, observer projections, SI units, and isolated-data meaning using its declared mathematical and batch-22 definition dependencies.
The local postulate explicitly reuses clause (iii) of post-sr-massive-particle-dynamics for complete isolated event data. It is an adopted assumption and is not represented as a proof or observation.

The incoming shell formulas give total (2 gamma m c,0). Conditional balance equates it to the sole rest output (M c,0), forcing M=2 gamma m; subtraction gives excess rest energy equal to incoming kinetic energy, with zero excess at v=0.

Specializing the complete two-body formulas to masses m,0 and total W=Mc^2 gives positive k and both energies under 0<m<M. The inverse momentum relation yields daughter speed, and subtraction splits the rest-energy difference into null energy and recoil kinetic energy.
